title: POST /stock/v1/inventory/search by guid and by multiLocationId answers MenuItemInventory rows, including IN_STOCK items with a null quantity

source.note: The page: the search body carries guids and/or multiLocationIds; 'Inventory information is returned for all menu items on the list, regardless of their inventory status (QUANTITY, OUT_OF_STOCK, or IN_STOCK)'; each row has guid, itemGuidValidity, status, quantity ('the amount of stock remaining for menu items with an inventory status of QUANTITY, and is null for OUT_OF_STOCK and IN_STOCK'), multiLocationId and versionId ('reserved for future use'); QUANTITY is 'in limited supply (1 or more items left)'. The seed keeps the Lemonade at a QUANTITY and the 8.99 soup IN_STOCK under the multiLocationId the page's example uses, 100000000171238879. The page's example also shows an INVALID row for an unknown guid with status OUT_OF_STOCK and multiLocationId 'null' (a string); the unit answers null there, and the case does not assert that row.
